item.subject: science
item.stem:
Riya places a bar magnet on her study table and holds a steel paper clip near it. She then slides a thin sheet of cardboard between the magnet and the paper clip.
What will happen to the paper clip?

options.A: The paper clip is pushed away from the magnet.
options.B: The paper clip is still attracted to the magnet, because the magnetic effect passes through cardboard.
options.C: The paper clip falls, because any sheet placed in between completely blocks the magnetic effect.
options.D: The paper clip becomes a permanent magnet and sticks to the cardboard.
